description:
**Innohacks 4.0** is the flagship national-level 24-hour hackathon organized by **Innogeeks**, the technical club of KIET Deemed to be University, Delhi-NCR, Ghaziabad. After three successful editions, Innohacks 4.0 is back to bring together developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers from across India.

With 6 exciting themes, Innohacks 4.0 is a platform to transform ideas into impactful technological solutions.

Whether you're building your first prototype or bringing years of technical experience to the table, this is your chance to **learn, collaborate, build, and showcase** what you can create.

# Hackathon Structure:

## 1. Idea PPT Submission Round

**2nd September 2026 to 26th September 2026**

The journey begins with your idea. Submit a PPT outlining your **problem statement, proposed solution, technology stack, and implementation approach**.

**Submit here:**
[**Round 1 Submission**](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe4VURd5rEZwdL-23-nLRYUMEcbvI4WNiBNBJVKqvMLZ7rT1w/viewform?usp=publish-editor)

**Follow this template for PPT submission:**
[**PPT Template**](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/15T9x0WYNaC1Qi6BirwIXckRCytc08Waep0fc1YFMOYg/edit?usp=sharing)

> **Note:** Simply registering on Devfolio does **not** guarantee shortlisting. To be eligible for consideration, teams **must submit their Idea PPT and GitHub team details by 25th September 2026**.

## 2. Offline Hackathon

**For 200 Hackers — 10th & 11th October 2026**

The top 50-100 teams will be shortlisted for the final **24-hour offline hackathon** at KIET Deemed to be University, where you'll turn your ideas into working prototypes, collaborate with your team, and present your solution to the judges.

# Mark your calendars for **October 10th and 11th, 2026!**

Get your team ready, bring your ideas, and prepare for **24 hours of building, learning, and innovation.**

**Join the [**Innohacks Discord Server**](https://discord.gg/yPX8vGzMmH) as a mandatory step!**

*Whether you're a **blockchain enthusiast**, an **AI aficionado**, or a **fintech wizard**, Innohacks 4.0 has something for everyone! From **AR/VR marvels** to **AIoT wonders**, get ready to push the boundaries of what's possible! ⚡*

# Visit our website for more details:

[**Innohacks 4.0**](https://www.innohacks.live/) 🪐

hackathon_faqs.answer: This is a student hackathon and only students are allowed to participate. You will be required to verify at the event by showing your student ID card.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who all can participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Of course you can! We at Innohacks ensure that no one is left behind during the hacking, thanks to our mentors and volunteers who help us achieve the same. We make sure that you learn the best you can alongside having fun and experiencing what it feels to belong to a community.
hackathon_faqs.question: I am a newbie, can I hack?

hackathon_faqs.answer: We don't want to monetize learning, community, and innovation. So, There is **no participation/registration fees**.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is there any registration fees for participation?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Please bring a valid university ID (or any student ID if in high school), a computer (preferably a laptop), chargers, and any hardware you will use for your hack. No firearms, weapons, alcohol, or illegal drugs are allowed on campus.
hackathon_faqs.question: What to bring to the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: **No.** In the interest of fairness, students should not be working on their projects before **Innohacks** begins and **we do not allow participants to work on pre-existing projects**. However, you can familiarize yourself with all the tools and technologies you intend to use beforehand.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can I start working on my hack before the event?

hackathon_faqs.answer:
We have arranged everything for you, including meals,
comfortable accommodations, and swags.

You're advised to bring your own broadband/hotspot device as we can arrange for at most one connection per team.
hackathon_faqs.question: What facilities will be provided to the participants?

hackathon_faqs.answer:
Beyond the competitive aspect, InnoHacks offers:

**Expert Mentorship**: Guidance from industry professionals.

**Networking**: Opportunities to connect with like-minded peers and experts.

**Skill Development**: Workshops and hands-on innovation sessions designed to enhance your technical knowledge.
hackathon_faqs.question: What can participants expect besides the competitions?
